Espresso machine FAQ

How often should I descale an espresso machine?

Descale every one to three months depending on how hard your water is. Hard water needs more frequent descaling to protect the heating element.

What is the best grind size for espresso?

A fine grind, similar to table salt, works for most machines.

Can I use pre-ground coffee?

Yes, but freshly ground beans give better flavor.

Portafilter?
The handle that holds the coffee basket.
